paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.4, with a change of -3.03% compared to the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 14, 2026.

There are 2 new news items in the last 24 hours, including a report from Kalkine Media about Fermi Inc.'s Q2 2026 SEC 10-Q report and a story from Bloomberg about the company receiving a US subpoena related to Project Matador. The subpoena is for certain documents related to the project, a data center campus being developed in west Texas.

There have been recent SEC filings, including a 10-Q form and multiple 8-K forms, with one of the 8-K forms disclosing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, and another disclosing the appointment of four new officers. There is also one Form 4 filing in the feed.
